title: Repository list when the user can reach several repos
context: Plugin must pick the repo itself: one attached or one reachable means carry on; several means show a short list. Question is what the list shows.

options.label: All reachable repos, recent first, ready ones marked
Only repos that pass the onboarded check
All repos, onboarded check only after the pick

rationale: Owner chose: list all reachable repos, recent first, mark which are ready, so a PO is not steered to a half-onboarded repo
